// purpose: @debuggen/chrome-extension: one program covering the devtools page, the React panel, the module service worker, the content bridge, manifest.config.ts, vite.config.ts and test/**. Vite + @crxjs builds the shipped bundle into dist/; tsc does not.
// format: Strict JSON, so notes are top-level `"// …"` keys, which TypeScript ignores; inside `compilerOptions` such a key is an error (TS5023).
// compilerOptions.emit: Declaration-only emit into .tsbuild, never dist/, which a developer loads unpacked and Playwright passes to --load-extension. Emit stays enabled because tests/tsconfig.json references this project, and `tsc -b` rejects a referenced project that disables emit (TS6310).
// compilerOptions.rootDir: "." because the inputs span src/, test/ and the two root-level configs.
// compilerOptions.lib: ES2023 plus DOM and DOM.Iterable (`lib` replaces the base array): every surface, the service worker included, runs in a browser context. No "WebWorker": its declarations conflict with DOM's (TS6200, silenced only by the inherited `skipLibCheck`), and the service worker needs nothing beyond `chrome.*` and the DOM-typed globals.
// compilerOptions.types: "chrome" for the `chrome.*` namespace. "node" serves only manifest.config.ts, vite.config.ts and test/**, but `types` applies program-wide, so the rule for src/** is kept by review: code bundled into browser contexts uses no `node:*` builtin, `process`, `Buffer` or `@debuggen/shared/node`.
// compilerOptions.jsx: Restates the base's "react-jsx" because the panel is written in .tsx.
// compilerOptions.module: `module`/`moduleResolution` are not overridden: bundler resolution matches Vite's resolver, and relative specifiers are extensionless.
// compilerOptions.resolveJsonModule: Inherited but unused: test/manifest.test.ts reads the built dist/manifest.json at runtime instead of importing it, so a build artefact never becomes a program input.
// compilerOptions.allowJs: Inherited false: public/agent.iife.js is the telemetry agent that scripts/copy-agent.mjs copies from packages/telemetry/dist, never a program input.
// compilerOptions.not-set: No `paths`/`baseUrl`: workspace packages resolve through the pnpm symlink and each package's `exports` map. Vite follows its runtime conditions into dist/; tsc follows its source-first `types` condition to src/ (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3).
// include: src/** and test/** in .ts and .tsx, plus manifest.config.ts, the manifest's permission and content-script contract, and vite.config.ts. The .html entry pages are Vite inputs, not program inputs.
// exclude: `exclude` replaces the base list, so dist, .tsbuild and node_modules are repeated; public/ holds copied assets, never sources.
// references: shared, telemetry, panel-schema, panel-renderer and protocol; they order the build, and `tsc -b` type-checks this program against their .tsbuild declarations, so `pnpm typecheck` never reads a stale dist/. Never add code-analysis, model-provider or instrumentation, which are service-side, or any apps/* workspace, which is reached over the wire or not at all.
